newsitem.title: DUBAI: Third candidate to run in Iran polls.
newsitem.headline: Third candidate to run in Iran polls.

text.p: A former Iranian minister of culture and Islamic guidance has formally announced his candidacy in the country's presidential elections, the official Iranian news agency IRNA reported on Wednesday night.

It said that Mohammad Khatami joins Parliament Speaker Ali Akbar Nateq-Nouri and Mohammad Mohammadi Reyshahri, a former information minister and leader of Iranian pilgrims to the annual haj in Saudi Arabia, in running for the president's post.
It said Khatami, 59, served as minister of culture and Islamic guidance between 1982 and 1992. "He is presently presidential advisor and president of Iran's national library."
The presidential polls to elect a successor to President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani are due to be held in May or June, but no precise date has been set, IRNA added.
Rafsanjani has served two successive four year terms and under Iran's constitution he is not allowed to run for a third term.
